strings.MainWindow.Title: Helldivers 2 Mod Manager
strings.HelpPage.Title: Help and guidance
strings.HelpPage.Introduction: Use these steps to configure the manager, import mods safely, and understand compatibility results.
strings.HelpPage.GettingStartedBody: Open Settings and select the Helldivers 2 game folder. The folder must contain data, tools, bin, and bin\helldivers2.exe. Choose a separate mod storage folder and review the deployment options before enabling mods.
strings.HelpPage.ImportBody: Use Create / Import to select an archive. The manager validates archive paths, size limits, and the manifest before making changes. An existing mod with the same identity is treated as an update and requires confirmation.
strings.HelpPage.CompatibilityBody: Compatibility is evaluated against the current game files. If a reliable game reference cannot be read, the result is shown as Unknown instead of guessing from other mods.
strings.HelpPage.SafetyBody: Keep backups until you have tested the mod in game. Experimental binary repair stays disabled by default and should only be enabled when you understand the generated repair plan and recovery path.
strings.HelpPage.SupportBody: Open the documentation for detailed workflows. When reporting a problem, include the app version and a redacted log, but never include API keys, pairing tokens, or private download URLs.

strings.VersionCheckDisclaimer.Title: Mod repair risk and usage notice
strings.VersionCheckDisclaimer.Message:
Mod repair rebuilds game resource structures, and automatic decisions cannot be guaranteed to work for every mod. A repaired mod may have invisible models, crash the equipment screen or game, or contain damaged files. HD2MM attempts to create backups, but you should also retain the original mod before repairing it.

Repaired mods are for your personal use only. Do not upload, share, resell, or redistribute them in any form. Rights to models, textures, and other assets remain with their original authors.

Selecting Confirm means that you understand and accept these risks and restrictions. This notice will not be shown again after acceptance.
